# THE ERA — Art of Living Green

> THE ERA is a luxury landscape architecture, professional gardening, curated plant, and plant-care solutions provider.

## Core Offerings & Services
- **Landscape Design & Architecture**: Bespoke garden concepts, spatial planning, residential & commercial landscape architecture, and refined outdoor environments.
- **Professional Gardening Services**: Garden setup, ongoing lawn care, pruning, tree maintenance, soil enrichment, and seasonal garden care.
- **Curated Plants & Delivery**: Hand-picked indoor foliage, air-purifying plants, outdoor ornamental plants, exotic trees, custom planters, and reliable delivery.
- **Plant Care & Nutrition**: Organic plant food, balanced fertilizers, plant health diagnostics, soil nutrition, and expert care consultations.

## Philosophy
DESIGN · NURTURE · DELIVER · TRANSFORM
